title: The Language You Ask In: Language-Conditioned Ideological Divergence in LLM Analysis of Contested Political Documents

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative comparative discourse analysis of LLM-generated texts analyzing a contested Ukrainian civil society document. The study examines lexical choices, rhetorical positioning, and interpretive conclusions to determine the model's ideological alignment (e.g., Western liberal-democratic vs. Russian statist-sovereigntist).

Administering semantically equivalent analytical prompts in two different languages (Russian and Ukrainian) to the same LLM, and comparing the outputs to evaluate if the prompt language systematically conditions the model's ideological framing and evaluative register.
